verdict.rationale: The pack never documents Perplexity creating, iteratively editing, or exporting documents, presentations, or other files. Perplexity Labs is only vaguely marketed as bringing "reports and projects to life," with no mention of file creation, editing, or export. The Computer/Agent API sandbox that runs code is a developer building block, and email drafting is an adjacent feature; neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have the assistant create and iteratively edit documents, presentations, and other files I can export
